references.text: Moses is instructed to gather the elders of Israel, as he also does here at Horeb
Moses used the staff to strike the Nile and turn the water into blood, the same staff mentioned here
The staff through which God gave Moses power, and which was used for signs and wonders
Moses uses the staff to part the Red Sea, another water miracle performed with the same staff
Moses gathers seventy of Israel's elders by the Lord's command, a similar leadership structure
A parallel account where Moses uses the staff to bring water from the rock
The psalm describes how God split rocks in the wilderness and gave the people water
Reference to when God opened the rock and water flowed out in the wilderness
The prophet recalls the water miracle when God split the rock for his people
Both verses show God's arrangement of leadership through Israel's elders, first during a crisis and later through institutionalization.
Direct narrative connection: 17:5 explicitly refers to the miracle at the Nile described in 7:19.
